clean_room_contracts_extracted.expert_definition_CORTI_VERBATIM: An Expert is an LLM-powered capability that an AI agent can utilize. Experts are designed to complete small, discrete tasks efficiently, enabling the Orchestrator to compose complex workflows by chaining multiple experts together.

icoder_charter_alignment.corti_definition: Expert = LLM-powered capability; small discrete tasks; composed by Orchestrator
icoder_charter_alignment.icoder_charter_§9_definition: Expert = discrete capability with structured I/O + declared dependencies + egress + citations + failure modes + deterministic/licence/maturity flags
icoder_charter_alignment.alignment_verdict: ALIGNED — Corti's public definition is consistent with iCoDer charter §9. iCoDer's clean-room taxonomy is a stricter superset (adds failure modes / licence / maturity).

OFFICIAL_CORTI_PUBLIC_EXPERT_LIST_9_KEYS.purpose_corti_verbatim: Recall and analyze content from large in-request contexts and files
Assign diagnosis and procedure codes from notes
Compute BMI, HbA1c, glucose conversions, etc.
Medication guidance and prescribing decision support
Search and retrieve up-to-date web content

clean_room_contracts_extracted.official_note: Corti notes this is 'a minimal sample of frequently-used experts' and refers to 'Available Experts overview' for full list including all coding-expert variants. A1B-AE.1 must also crawl that page to discover additional variants.

bring_your_own_expert.mechanism: expose an MCP server; Corti wraps it in a custom LLM agent with a system prompt
capabilities: Integrate own tools and data sources
Maintain control via custom system prompts
Leverage Corti orchestration + memory while using own tools

example_verbatim.name: ECG Interpreter
example_verbatim.systemPrompt: You are an expert ECG interpreter.

requirements_verbatim: Implement the Model Context Protocol specification
Expose tools via the standard MCP tools/list and tools/call endpoints
mcp_server_schema_PUBLIC.icoder_note: Charter §6.4 strictly forbids storing plaintext secret in MCP registry record. iCoDer McpServerRegistry will store secret_reference (lookup key) not the secret itself.

multi_agent_composition.corti_status: COMING SOON (publicly announced, not yet shipped)
corti_plan_verbatim: Direct agent-to-agent communication using the A2A protocol

Fine-grained control over agent interactions and data flow
multi_agent_composition.icoder_implication: iCoDer A1B-AE can implement this clean-room without trailing Corti, but must NOT mark `CORTI_PARITY` since Corti itself has not shipped.

direct_expert_calls.corti_status: COMING SOON (publicly announced, not yet shipped)

direct_expert_calls.icoder_implication: iCoDer A1B-AE.4 will offer Direct Expert Calls as part of Agent CRUD (clean-room lead over public Corti). Verdict must NOT claim Corti parity.

clean_room_contracts_extracted.api_first_positioning_verbatim: The Corti Agentic Framework is API-first, enabling synchronous or async usage across a range of modalities: scheduled batch jobs, clinical event triggers, UI widgets, and direct EHR system calls.
